title: Fix CI failures by specifying pnpm version in all workflows
body:
CI was failing with `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE` across all workflows due to pnpm version mismatch between lockfile generation (10.31.0) and CI execution.

## Changes

- Add explicit `version: 10.31.0` to all `pnpm/action-setup@v6` steps across 9 workflow files
- Ensures CI uses the same pnpm version specified in `package.json` `packageManager` field

## Affected Workflows

- ci.yml (4 jobs)
- changeset-release.yml
- dependabot-auto-merge.yml
- lint.yml
- performance-budget.yml
- release.yml
- shadcn-check.yml
- storybook-deploy.yml
- storybook-tests.yml
